messages:
Maria (AE): quick sync — ACME asked for a joint on-prem POC using our Private deployment + HSM. They want: architecture diagram, estimated cost delta vs hosted, SSO/SAML flow, network/egress requirements, and answers for their security questionnaire. looping in @Kevin (PE) @Jasmin (SE) and security-bot to scope. can we get a short checklist by EOD?

Kevin (PE): ack. can you confirm expected throughput (rps) and target latency SLA? that'll change how we size dedicated pool and batching. also: is this fully air-gapped or VPC-peered? HSM integration route differs.

Maria (AE): they said ~200 concurrent sessions, avg prompt len ~120 tokens, goal p95 latency <= 400ms. customer prefers VPC peering but asked about an air-gap option as backup.

Jasmin (SE): for 200 concurrent + 120 tokens, recommend starting with 8x A100-style reserved GPUs (dedicated pool) with aggressive KV caching and continuous batching. if we use quantized 4-bit model variant we can shave cost ~25% but need validation on hallucination risk.

Sam (Eng): FYI HSM integration: we support external HSM via PKCS#11; customer will need cert provisioning and a small agent on their side. on-prem air-gapped adds ~2 weeks ops work (networking + manual key exchange) and likely requires an on-site engineer for initial handoff.

Kevin (PE): rough pricing delta (ballpark): hosted: $X per token (variable). Private/reserved 8-GPU pool amortized = ~$1200–$1800/hr depending on instance and commitment. if they want HSM + SSO + premium retention, add a ~$2.5k setup + $300/mo security package. these are estimates — finance will refine. :money_with_wings:

Maria (AE): good — please put that in a one-pager. partner needs a runbook we can share with their infra team.

Jasmin (SE): draft runbook outline: 1) tenant provisioning 2) VPC peering steps and subnet/CIDR list 3) SAML config (IdP metadata exchange) 4) HSM cert exchange + PKCS#11 endpoint 5) test harness (small loadgen) 6) rollback/fallback to hosted model. i can write the 1pager.

Kevin (PE): sample config snippet for tenant provisioning (share with infra):

```
# redwoodctl example (on our control plane)
redwoodctl tenant create --name acme-poc --deployment private --vpc-peering cidr=10.2.0.0/16 --hsm pkcs11_url=https://hsm.acme.example --saml idp_metadata=./acme-idp.xml
```

Kevin (PE): also note network egress: if they enable telemetry back to our control plane, open outbound TLS to api.redwood.example:443 from the inference subnet. if they want zero egress, we'll need to run with full local telemetry buffer and arrange secure offline transfers.

security-bot: Security questionnaire starting checklist: link: https://redwood.example.com/sec-qna-template (internal). Required items for this POC: encryption-at-rest details, HSM integration doc, key lifecycle, SOC2 controls mapping, SAML IDP metadata, audit log retention, and a contact for incident response. please attach SOC2+ISO certs.

Sam (Eng): blocking item: ACME legal flagged that our default telemetry contains minimal metadata. if they need strict PII filtering we must add a pre-send filter in the POC (small dev task, ~3 days). also air-gap will block automatic updates.

Maria (AE): ok action items: Kevin — finalize one-pager + tenant command; Jasmin — write runbook outline and test harness steps; Sam — short note on HSM dev tasks & air-gap impacts; security-bot — populate sec-qna answers and certs. i'll collate and send to ACME and schedule a 30m tech handoff for tomorrow 10am PT. :thumbsup:

Kevin (PE): ack, i'll post the draft here when ready.

Jasmin (SE): will add test scripts and expected metrics to the runbook.

Sam (Eng): i'll scope the dev work and estimate timeline.

security-bot: uploaded initial sec answers to https://redwood.example.com/internal/acme-poc/sec-answers (internal).

Maria (AE): thanks team — i'll loop partner and confirm the call.
